items.title: 2.8 Electronic configuration aur periodic table (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.8, printed page 38, with Quick Check 2.5 and answers.

blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke elements ki electron configuration periodic table mein un ki jagah se judi hai. Periodic table is tarah bana hai ke jin elements ke bahar wale shell (valence shell) ki configuration ka pattern ek jaisa ho, woh ek hi group mein aate hain.

Is liye periodic table mein kisi element ki jagah dekh kar us ki configuration aasani se likhi ja sakti hai. Yeh pattern Figure 2.15 mein hai. Elements ko is baat par bhi group kiya ja sakta hai ke un ka aakhri electron kis qism ke orbital mein jata hai.

items: Baen taraf do columns: alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals (groups 1 aur 2). In mein bahar wale shell ka s orbital bhar raha hai; group 1 ki configuration ns¹ aur group 2 ki ns². Group 13 par jayein to ns²np¹.
Daen taraf chhe columns ka block: in mein sab se bahar wale ‘p’ orbitals bhar rahe hain.
Beech mein das columns ka block: transition metals, jin mein d orbitals bhar rahe hain.
Neeche alag do rows, chaudah columns: f-block elements, jin mein ‘f’ orbitals bhar rahe hain.

blocks.text: Yaad karein: 2, 6, 10 aur 14 bilkul utne hi electrons hain jitne s, p, d aur f subshells mein aa sakte hain. Isi liye blocks ki chaurai (columns) 2, 6, 10 aur 14 hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Periodic table ki madad se noble gas core aur us ke baad ke electrons ke saath configuration likhein: (i) ₄₈Cd (ii) ₅₇La.
blocks.explanation: (i) Cadmium period 5 ke d block ke aakhir mein hai: [Kr] 4d¹⁰ 5s². (ii) Lanthanum 6s² ke baad aata hai: [Xe] 5d¹ 6s².

blocks.prompt: b) Antimony (Sb, Z = 51) ki poori configuration likhein.
c) ₅₁Sb ke har atom mein kitne unpaired electrons hain?
blocks.explanation: Teen. 5p³ ke teen electrons Hund ke rule se teen alag p orbitals mein ek ek baithte hain.

items: Table mein jagah se configuration: groups 1, 2 = ns¹, ns²; groups 13-18 = ns²np¹ se ns²np⁶; beech ke 10 columns = d; neeche ke 14 columns = f.
Block ki chaurai = subshell ki capacity: 2, 6, 10, 14.
